finding: Kickoff Gourmandelle excerpt claimed sandwich use; live article now only names cooked patties served with mash, yogurt sauce or salad. That excerpt is not used as sandwich evidence.
resolution: Live Daniela Niculi article body directly bakes vegetable/quinoa patties and assembles them with bread, greens and sauce. That supports the game pairing without relying on the stale Gourmandelle excerpt.

sources.caveat: Title says vegan; body contains eggs, feta and yogurt. No vegan claim appears in game.

sources.allowed_support: Cooking patties only; no sandwich assembly claim.
